scope: scripts/qualify_hardware_changes.py --slice restores on a frozen Debug build of 89b5197f (artifacts/hf8, git archive) whose worker bundles the 13-profile capability contract, 113/113 steps, in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with an added CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 on one subnet and an ET 200MP IM 155-5 PN ST V4.1 and an ET 200SP IM 155-6 PN ST V6.4 station assigned to it, three catalog-selected DI 8x24VDC ST (6ES7 131-6BF00-0BA0 V1.1) in the ET 200SP rack: hardware_catalog_search names that module's capability profile; a hardware_attributes write of InformationText, which the profile does not declare, is refused by the profile (AttributeNotWritable); each applied with asserted preview, checkpoint, device compile and save, exact state deltas and restored into a new directory equal to the pre-change state: the shared-device assignment (connector 1 joins a new IO system of the scratch CPU with SpDi3 moving to it through SharedDeviceAssignmentTarget, the preview listing its target before and after, and the worker's preservation with every item's shared-device attributes: only SpDi3's subtree changed owner and target), SpDi4 OutsideOfProject with one external IO controller, the scratch CPU as MRP manager creating domain HwRing, and the IM 155-5 PN ST joining it as client; typed refusals change nothing.
limitations: A slice: no S7-1200, no port links (no ring is closed), no fresh-Portal reopen; persistence of these kinds rests on local.hardware_changes.topology.20261101.

Profile gates on one module type (DI 8x24VDC ST 6ES7 131-6BF00-0BA0 V1.1): one catalog link and one refused undeclared item attribute; channel-attribute and versionless-profile refusals are not exercised natively.

Shared assignment with the scratch CPU's I/O address space empty: SpDi3 keeps start address 0; the start move into an occupied space is local.hardware_changes.topology.20261101. The sharedDevice disconnect is not exercised.
The network_mrp_set port-link refusal (a ring port linked to a non-ring port) and the hardware_shared_device_access PLC-to-PLC refusal are not exercised natively.
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and no physical topology is observed.
